title: LastItems
description: A plugin for unique items with extensive customization and flexibility for versions 1.16.5 - 26.1.2
body:
## This is a powerful plugin for creating unique items, offering extensive customisation options and flexible configuration.

Features and functions of the plugin:

- Unique effects for items, with maximum flexibility in customisation—from executing console commands and displaying stylish messages to knocking back enemies and unleashing lightning strikes
- Full support for the latest versions 1.16.5 - 26.1.2, including all the new features such as armour textures, gliders, custom stack sizes and spell glow overrides
- Detailed customisation of the items themselves, with the option to create unique heads based on Base64 or the player’s nickname, add custom attributes, potion effects and CustomModelData
- An advanced trigger system with activation probabilities and click or hit counters, as well as intelligent alternative actions in case the player misses or fails to find a target
Built-in usage control with customisable delays, support for stylish time formatting, the ability to cancel vanilla events, and the option to retrieve an item directly from the player’s hands after successful application
- A built-in advanced text parser that instantly processes modern MiniMessage tags (<red>, <gradient\:#FFFFFF\:#FF3333>), any HEX colours (#RRGGBB) and legacy codes (&a, &l) for perfect rendering of lore and titles
- A powerful system of local placeholders featuring statistics on the player and their target—ranging from current health to biome and line of sight—plus full integration with the PlaceholderAPI across all modules

---

## Dependencies:

- [BLibV2](https://github.com/By1337/BLibV2/releases)
- [PlaceholderAPI](https://github.com/PlaceholderAPI/PlaceholderAPI/releases) (optional)
